title: Binary encoding of a labeled sample
statement: For a natural number $n$, convert a labeled sample consisting of a sign vector in $\{\pm1\}^n$ and a sign label into a pair consisting of its corresponding vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and its corresponding bit in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
